headline: From evaluation to full production adoption
challenge: Move production applications off a self-managed distributed SQL engine without disruption.
action: Led the migration working group and cutover war room, then built the post-migration operating model (a two-day workshop, a runbook, and diagnostic queries) and handed ownership to the customer’s teams.
result: 100% production adoption, with the incumbent engine retired.

headline: Retrieval architecture for semantic video search
challenge: Search 100–200B embeddings, growing about 2B a day, across 9 AWS Regions.
action: Advised on the production vector architecture and its operational tradeoffs, including replication and compute re-platforming.
result: In production on PostgreSQL and pgvector at about 150 TB, built and run by the customer’s teams.

headline: AI search in under a second
challenge: AI search over hundreds of millions of vectors was too slow under tens of millions of writes a day.
action: Re-architected the retrieval path for read latency under constant write load.
result: Latency down from over 15 seconds to under one second.

headline: A semantic data layer: LLM at the edges, determinism in the core
challenge: Answer natural-language business questions against a tenant’s own objects, reliably.
action: Built the proof of value end to end as a forward-deployed engineer: a four-stage pipeline (intent, context, concept, tenant object) where the model interprets language and deterministic code resolves it, on Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, and pgvector.
result: Fixed a delivery-blocking agent state defect, stood up the evaluation framework, and handed over a documented repository.

headline: An adoption roadmap across hundreds of applications
challenge: Modernize a database estate of thousands of instances.
action: Owned the technical account plan and built champions from engineering leads to platform executives.
result: The bank now runs its own database Center of Excellence.
